name: antibes-holiday
title_zh: 把概念或参考图转成松弛手绘黑笔线条画
tagline_zh: 想要快速手绘线稿能量，但自己画不出那种“不齐整”的松弛感？它专治结构太正、比例太稳、线条太死——产出稀疏插画。
tagline_en: Want quick hand-drawn line energy but can't fake the 'off-kilter' ease? It handles sparse scenes, animals.
desc_en: Create original relaxed black-pen graphics from concepts or visual references, including sparse illustrations, narrative scenes, animals, objects, abstract relationships, icons, and logo marks. Use when the user wants quick hand-drawn line energy, causal story staging, non-equilibrium proportion, shorthand forms, open contours, structural line drift, misregistered junctions, selective retracing, p
why_zh: 机制上不是“描边滤镜”，而是从构图阶段就注入非均衡比例、开放轮廓、选择性复描和错位接点。
why_en: Not a trace filter—it bakes non-equilibrium proportion, open contours, selective retracing, and misregistered junctions into the.
limit_zh: 只吃“概念描述”或“视觉参考图”，不吃照片写实或精细渲染需求；产物是黑白线稿草图，不含上色、阴影或最终完稿。
limit_en: Inputs: concepts or visual refs only—no photorealism or fine rendering. Outputs: loose B&W line sketches only; no color, shading, or final polish.
title_en: Turn concepts or references into relaxed hand-drawn.
